stem.text: Emphysema is a type of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). A person with emphysema has difficulties in breathing out.
Why does emphysema cause difficulties in breathing out?

A.text: Smooth muscle fibres in the airways are destroyed.

B.text: Too little mucus is produced in the bronchi.

C.text: The elasticity of the alveoli decreases.

D.text: The surface area of the alveoli becomes larger.
